commands.lifecycle: serial; one process per cell; declared 20 warm complete requests; uncontrolled OS page cache

environment.lifecycle: serial one fresh process per cell plus20same-context warm complete requests; OS caches and background load uncontrolled; two blind graders reading existing JSON source packets concurrently; idle approved user preview4972 remains running

inventory.lifecycle: Separate retained service process for every scenario/profile cell; first inventory request cold,20 subsequent complete warm endpoint calls in same process/context;21 stable responses per cell.
inventory.peak_scope: True process peak across service startup plus21inventory requests, not per-request; all10task-owned servers intentionally terminated after their cells.
inventory.platform_cache_limit: OS page cache/background load uncontrolled; cold definition is fresh process, not disk-cold. HTTPstartup time excluded from endpoint samples and recorded separately.
inventory.provenance: execution-plan.json binds exact03b productbinary SHA and original buildreceipt plus current observed source state. Tracked source may change after binary build; no rebuild was performed. Frozen source/artifact/profile/selector identities are checked on every request.
inventory.sql_stage_metrics: Product HTTP inventory API exposes no internal stage/SQLread counters; these timings cover complete endpoint request and response transfer only.

scope: complete production algorithm in instrumented atlas-dev;32freshprocesses each1cold+20same-contextwarm requests
sql_counters: partial instrumented index reads; not complete SQLite trace
